text: A steady, predictable income every month
Knowing the job will still be there in ten years
Clear rules and a settled routine at work
Deciding for myself how my work gets done
Working without someone checking on me
Choosing my own hours and where I work from
Being known as someone who is good at what they do
Getting credit openly when my work goes well
A job my family and friends respect
Work that makes someone's life measurably better
Spending my day looking after, teaching or advising people
Giving something back to my community through my job
Making things nobody has made before
Using my imagination every single day
Being free to try an unusual approach
Leading a team towards a goal
Having a say in the big decisions
Being responsible for other people's work
